decision.reason: [ev-bd974cd20c42] does show that a new "xpkg batch" command was added, so the change type "added" is supported. The subject doesn't fit, though. "xpkg batch" is a CLI subcommand, not a flag, and the cli-flag family requires a name that starts with "--". None of the other subject families covers a CLI subcommand, so this assertion can't be spelled correctly in the current vocabulary. I'm deferring because of that gap in the families, not because the evidence is missing.
